notes.body: I did basically the same thing in !8583 using the preexisting function `get_clamped_length()`. I don't have strong feelings, either MR could go through to solve the build issues. My change will apply the new EI to both TCPCLv3 and v4 cases where this happens (v4 has fewer 64-bit lengths).
